import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-26de1145.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator lines divide the grid into equal-sized cells. Reflect the
    # pattern from the upper-left cell across each separator in alternating tiles.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and grid[r][0] != 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != 1]
    # The separator color is the common non-background color (6 in these tasks).
    color = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == color for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == color for row in grid)]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ti in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        ra, rb = row_bounds[ti]+1, row_bounds[ti+1]
        if rb <= ra: continue
        for tj in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            ca, cb = col_bounds[tj]+1, col_bounds[tj+1]
            if cb <= ca or (ti == 0 and tj == 0): continue
            for r in range(ra, rb):
                sr = row_bounds[0]+1 + ((rb-ra-1-(r-ra)) if ti%2 else r-ra)
                for c in range(ca, cb):
                    sc = col_bounds[0]+1 + ((cb-ca-1-(c-ca)) if tj%2 else c-ca)
                    if sr < h and sc < w and grid[sr][sc] != color:
                        out[r][c] = grid[sr][sc]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
